manifest.title: Stricter gates: motionless images pass them; a planted vibration is not recovered

params.profile: ICEYE X13 Khafre four side W50 Track10 profile

finding: A gated version of the method, run unchanged on 7 loops round Khafre's faces in the 2022 image (2,828 positions), passes 5 positions (1 feature) on the real image, 13 and 8 (3 and 2) on two motionless twins of it, with nothing moving and nothing inside, and 0 (0) on the same loops laid on open desert in the same image. With the faces made to vibrate at 2 mm/s along the line of sight, some 40,000 times Giza's microseisms, it passes 9 (2): the real image's feature again, and 1 new one, at mode 3 (3.2 Hz) on the north face, planted at 0.26 Hz. Each image of its pairs spans 6.0 s of the pass and the two share 98.75% of their spectrum: 36% of its shifts are exactly zero and 75% within one 0.01 px step, and the planted vibrations move them by 0.006 px at 0.26 Hz and 0.002 px at 3.66 Hz, where a tracker following them fully would see 0.063 and 0.016 px. Its modes stand for 1.07 to 10.7 Hz, where a 6.0 s image keeps at most 4.7% of a motion; a vibrating point's shifts trace an ellipse at least 3,000 times as long as it is wide, and the gate keeps only those at most 10 times. Of the 35 passing positions, 31 have their best depth within half a cycle of their mode times 6.17 m or its mirror (308.7 m less that), against 4% by chance.
